attempts.observed_failure: Built-in task options were placed below parameters instead of parameters.ocr_options, so both calls silently returned ordinary OCR.
attempts.implementation_correction: Moved task and task_config to parameters.ocr_options.

attempts.observed_failure: KIE copied long result-schema descriptions or returned labels instead of values.
attempts.implementation_correction: Shortened KIE hints and separated positioned text from safety routing.

attempts.observed_failure: KIE remained unstable on the same images; date matching also treated non-date text as a date candidate.
attempts.implementation_correction: Removed KIE from the operational route and introduced deterministic label/value parsing over advanced-recognition words.

attempts.observed_failure: ISO date hyphens were interpreted as negative signs, leaving five date locators unresolved.
attempts.implementation_correction: Changed date matching to compare digit groups and added an ISO-date regression case.

attempts.observed_failure: The right-cropped values were all positioned but did not touch the physical page edge, so the initial edge-margin rule did not fire.
attempts.implementation_correction: Added a cross-field rule for three or more right edges aligned on the same vertical cut line.

separate_diagnostics.reason: Two node -e probes failed locally because of module-format and quoting errors; no API request was sent.
separate_diagnostics.conclusion: Empty KIE descriptions fixed copying but confused amount semantics; concise prompts fixed the clean sample but did not detect the visual stamp; a separate OCR yes/no obstruction prompt returned NO for both clean and stamp images.

evidence_boundary: All images are synthetic development fixtures. Attempt iteration on the same images is not independent evaluation or production accuracy.
